name: Woomie's Psychosis
source:
Overworked, tired, and underpaid. That's the kind of position that your current job is putting you in but without a choice and rent still needing to be paid, you persist through your job working in a news & media company.  When your tiredness finally catches up to you and you find your late to work, your manager Larry is on the brink of firing you. 

However, he gives you one last chance to show your use to the company or else you’ll be out of a job.  That opportunity ends up being an interview with a well known singer who goes by the name of “Woomie” working under a company called Aurum more specifically (Aurum Loan Co.)  Recent scandals have arisen from numerous rumors surrounding him about a potential romantic affair but no one seems to be able to get a proper interview with him as the last who tried, went insane.

Your last chance to save your job is to interview Woomie, whose facade slowly falters the deeper you explore into his mind, but the deeper you reach, the more you seem to lose track of yourself as well.

[From [url=https://burnt-bun.itch.io/woomies-psychosis]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
工作过度、劳累、工资低。这就是你目前的工作给你带来的那种职位，但你别无选择，而且还需要支付租金，你只能坚持在新闻媒体公司工作。当你终于感到疲倦并且发现上班迟到时，你的经理拉里正处于解雇你的边缘。

然而，他给了你最后一次机会向公司展示你的用处，否则你就会失业。这个机会最终成为了对一位名叫“Woomie”的知名歌手的采访，他在一家名为Aurum的公司（更具体地说，Aurum Loan Co.）工作。最近的丑闻源于围绕他潜在的浪漫关系的众多谣言，但似乎没有人能够获得对他的适当采访，因为最后一个尝试采访的人都疯了。

你保住饭碗的最后机会是采访伍米，随着你对他内心的探索越深入，他的外表就会慢慢动摇，但你越深入，你似乎就越失去了自己的踪迹。

[来自[url=https://burnt-bun.itch.io/woomies-psychosis]itch.io[/url]]
